description: Source code implementing an RPC server interface for media browsing using RBUS, including method handlers for discovering media devices, retrieving server details, and browsing server contents.

methods.name: remoteMethodHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming RBUS method calls for media device discovery, server details, and content browsing.

methods.name: getServerDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific media server based on input parameters.

methods.name: getServerContents
methods.description: Retrieves content listing from a media server based on UDN and path.

methods.name: init_ipc_iface
methods.description: Initializes the RBUS interface and registers method handlers.

methods.name: close_rpc_iface
methods.description: Unregisters data elements and closes the RBUS interface.
